models.name: GPT-6.1 Sol
models.note: API specifications for GPT-6.1 Sol. Your reported ChatGPT label is 6.1; that abbreviated label alone does not establish Sol or a backend snapshot.

security.risk: OpenAI classifies GPT-6.1 Sol as Critical capability in cybersecurity, High in biological/chemical capability, and below the High threshold for AI self-improvement under its Preparedness Framework.
security.safeguards: OpenAI states that GPT-6.1 Sol uses the same safeguards stack as GPT-6 Astra, including deployment monitoring and controls for malicious use and unauthorized model activity.
security.testing: The system-card addendum reports static and multi-turn jailbreak evaluations, realistic work-environment misalignment evaluations, and monitor-evasion testing.
security.limit: These are OpenAI evaluations and deployment claims, not an independent penetration test by Model Label. The card also reports residual failure modes, so the result is not a guarantee of security.

models.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
models.note: Published Gemini API input and output limits. A stable identifier is not proof of the release serving the consumer app or America.gov.

security.risk: Google reports that Gemini 3.8 Flash is unlikely to reach any Tracked or Critical Capability Levels under its April 2026 Frontier Safety Framework assessment.
security.safeguards: Google reports continued work on jailbreak resistance, safety-policy mitigations, and specialist human red teaming outside the model-development team.
security.testing: The model card reports automated text, multilingual and image safety evaluations plus manual red teaming; multilingual safety showed a small regression relative to Gemini 3.7 Flash.
security.limit: Provider evaluations are informative but do not establish the security of every downstream deployment, tool connection, retrieval layer or system prompt.

models.name: Claude Fable 5.1
models.note: Provider publishes 1M context and 128K output. Training data cutoff: June 2026. M/K notation is expanded for display. This does not identify a Claude consumer chat.

security.risk: Anthropic reports deploying Claude Fable 5.1 with ASL-3 protections, treating it as having CB-1 capabilities, with autonomy threat model 1 applicable.
security.safeguards: Anthropic reports extensive stress-testing of Fable 5.1 cybersecurity safeguards, including external testing and automated Gray Swan testing.
security.testing: Anthropic states that it found no evidence of a critical-severity jailbreak for the tested Fable 5.1 cybersecurity safeguards.
security.limit: This is Anthropic's reported assessment. Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 share model capabilities but use different safeguard configurations, so deployment context matters.

environment_references.name: Gemini Apps text prompt
environment_references.scope: Provider-estimated median serving footprint, including idle capacity, CPU/RAM and data-centre overhead. Carbon applies the 2024 fleetwide grid intensity. Not independently verified; not a measurement of Gemini 3.8 or America.gov.

environment_references.name: Conventional Google search
environment_references.scope: Historical provider estimate including search-index work. Energy converted from 0.0003 kWh. Not a current web-search measurement; not AI search. Different years and boundaries prevent a valid efficiency ranking.

creation_records.energy_method: Modelled final-run dynamic GPU energy: 433,196 kWh / 1,000. GPU hours × rated power; not real-time electricity metering.
creation_records.carbon_basis: Approximate final-run dynamic emissions; 57 g CO₂e/kWh French grid factor. Broader 50.5 t includes allocated equipment manufacture and energy-based operational consumption. These totals are alternatives with different boundaries, not additive.
creation_records.full_development: Not established as a complete all-development footprint here. The study separately discusses intermediate experiments; the final-run figures do not include all research and development.
creation_records.updates: No dated update/fine-tuning footprint established in this record.

creation_records.energy_method: Electricity total not separately extracted as a measured value. Provider reports 30.84 million H100 GPU-hours and 700 W rated GPU power. These are compute/power disclosures, not metered whole-facility electricity.
creation_records.carbon_basis: Provider-estimated location-based training emissions: 8,930 tons CO₂eq. Separately reports 0 market-based tons under renewable-electricity matching. Market-based zero is an accounting claim, not zero electricity consumption or zero physical impact. Source uses “tons”; no mass-unit reinterpretation applied.
creation_records.full_development: Complete experiments, data preparation, hardware manufacture and all development stages are not established by this training row.
creation_records.updates: No per-release update/fine-tuning energy or carbon series established in this record.

inference_scenario.scope: Bottom-up scenarios for >200B-parameter models on H100 nodes, with throughput, node power and overhead assumptions. The interquartile range describes study scenarios, not a confidence interval or a bound on all queries. Long-query scenario uses 15× test-time scaling.
inference_scenario.excludes: Not a measurement of any currently selected API. Training, user devices and whole lifecycle are not included in this serving-energy scenario.

creation_scenario.boundary: One final training run. Excludes development experiments, staff, data acquisition, hardware manufacture and later updates. Range is an analyst-selected scenario, not a confidence interval or model-specific measurement.
creation_scenario.basis: 1–30 million H100-equivalent GPU-hours, 0.7 kW per GPU, ×1.2 host allowance, ×1.2 facility overhead; illustrative electricity factor 0.4 kg CO₂e/kWh and rental price US$3/GPU-hour. Hours, overheads, grid and rental price are explicit assumptions. Actual costs can lie outside this range.

security_scope: Model-specific security information is provider-reported unless explicitly marked otherwise. It does not constitute an independent penetration test or establish a downstream deployment's full security posture.

america-gov.risk: Exact serving model, release, routing and deployment-specific security controls are not established in the public evidence captured by this demo.
america-gov.safeguards: Google's Gemini model-level safeguards cannot be assumed to describe every America.gov serving control, retrieval layer, system instruction or government-side access control.
america-gov.testing: No independent penetration test or deployment-specific security evaluation is recorded by Model Label.
america-gov.limit: The supplier announcement establishes a Gemini technology partnership, not the complete security configuration of the live government portal.
